title: Water Consumption by State and Sector
description: Annual water consumption by state, broken down into domestic and non-domestic sectors.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia, which has been included for ease of analysis

fields.name: sector
fields.title: Sector
fields.description: [Categorical] Either the domestic ('domestic') or non-domestic ('nondomestic') sector

fields.name: value
fields.title: Water Consumption
fields.description: [Float] Amount of water consumed in millions of litres per day (MLD)

methodology:
In Malaysia, all public and private operators of water provision services must be licensed by the National Water Services Commission (SPAN), and must report key performance indicators as specified in the terms of the license issued by SPAN. This dataset represents part of that reporting, and is compiled from the transactional operational records of water supply companies across Malaysia. Classification into domestic and non-domestic sectors is based on the purpose of water usage registered with the operator for each user account. It should be noted that:
- Data for Sarawak includes LAKU Management Sdn. Bhd. (Bintulu, Miri & Limbang, Sibu Water Board, Kuching Water Board and Sarawak Rural Water Supply Department (JBALB).
- Data for W.P. Kuala Lumpur and W.P. Putrajaya are subsumed under Selangor.
caveat: Data for the most recent year is provisional and may be revised in future updates.
